description: This file implements the stub and proxy classes for the IUnknown interface within the WPEFramework's RPC system. It handles reference counting, interface querying, and socket communication for remote objects.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Stub class handling incoming RPC calls for IUnknown, managing reference counting and interface querying.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class providing client-side access to remote IUnknown objects, including socket retrieval.

classes.name: UnknownInstantiation
classes.description: Static class responsible for registering and deregistering the IUnknown interface with the RPC administrator.

methods.name: UnknownStub::Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming RPC messages based on method index, performing AddRef, Release, or QueryInterface operations.

methods.name: UnknownProxy::Socket
methods.description: Returns the socket port associated with the proxy's communication channel.
